chunks: Al-Nuḍr from al-Ḥalabī from Abū Saʿīd al-Makkārī from Abū Baṣīr from Abū Jaʿfar (peace be upon him) regarding the saying of Allah, the Exalted:
Then they will all be hurled headlong into Hell, along with the deviant ones.
He said: “[O Abā Baṣīr], they are a group who described justice with their tongues then contravene it with something else [in action].”

key_terms.الْغَاوُونَ: The deviant ones / those who go astray

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'deviant ones' mentioned in Surah Ash-Shu'ara verse 94?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Kitab al-Zuhd*, Abū Jaʿfar (peace be upon him) interprets the 'deviant ones' (al-ghāwūn) in Surah As-Saffat as those who verbally profess justice but contradict it through their actions, highlighting the core Shia concept of *nifaq* (hypocrisy) where inner reality diverges from outward claim. This explanation underscores the danger of self-deception and the necessity of aligning one's deeds with one's declarations, a key theme in Zuhd literature regarding the purification of the heart from conceit.
